cases.name: safe-path
cases.goal: Reject path traversal in public helper

solution.paths.py:
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
def valid(name):
 p=PurePosixPath(name)
 return bool(name) and not p.is_absolute() and ".." not in p.parts

cases.test:
from paths import valid
def test_traversal(): assert valid("src/a.py") and not valid("../private") and not valid("/private")

cases.name: cpp-header
cases.goal: Provide an inline integer sum function

solution.sum.hpp:
#pragma once
inline int add(int a,int b) { return a+b; }

cases.test:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import shutil
def test_cpp(tmp_path):
 compiler=shutil.which("c++")
 assert compiler, "C++ compiler required"
 source=tmp_path/"main.cpp"
 source.write_text('#include "sum.hpp"\nint main(){return add(2,3)==5?0:1;}\n')
 target=tmp_path/"check"
 subprocess.run([compiler,"-I",str(Path.cwd()),str(source),"-o",str(target)],check=True)
 assert subprocess.run([str(target)]).returncode==0
